snippet.title: Age of Empires IV: Yue Fei's Legacy Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Pre-order Yue Fei's Legacy now and save 15%. Live the legacy of Yue Fei as he leads the Song Dynasty forces in a fight for survival against the ruthless Jin Dynasty invaders with his fellow commander, Han Shizhong, in a bold campaign. Strike back after the northern Chinese heartland falls and rally shattered armies into an impassioned stand for your country’s survival against a seemingly unstoppable enemy. 

This is the legendary struggle to save a collapsing empire and its people, retold as an epic Age of Empires IV campaign. 

Pre-order to be ready on day one to explore four new maps and two new biomes. Immerse yourself in new Jin Dynasty civilization music, push through fresh Jin masteries and carry everything into skirmish and multiplayer, where the Jin Dynasty joins the full civ roster for casual matches, custom games and intense ranked play. 

*This expansion is inspired by historical events with artistic liberties for gameplay. 

Audio Description: https://youtu.be/eOfIfAmQwJI

Stay connected with Age of Empires!
